## Next Step: Add Topics on GitHub Web Interface

To complete the repository setup, you need to add topics through GitHub's web interface:

### How to Add Topics:

1. **Navigate to your repository** on GitHub:
   `https://github.com/MuhammadAyanSajid/Intelligent-Courier-Logistics-Engine`

2. **Click the gear icon (⚙️)** next to "About" in the right sidebar

3. **Add topics** in the "Topics" field. Copy and paste these recommended topics:

   ```
   courier-management
   logistics
   routing
   tracking-system
   data-structures
   algorithms
   dijkstra-algorithm
   cpp
   cplusplus
   nodejs
   express
   graph-algorithms
   delivery-management
   queue
   heap
   educational-project
   dsa
   web-application
   console-application
   fleet-management
   ```

4. **Optionally update the description** in the same dialog box with:
   ```
   A comprehensive courier logistics management system with intelligent routing, real-time tracking, and dual-interface architecture (C++ Console + Web Application). Implements advanced data structures and algorithms for solving real-world logistics challenges.
   ```

5. **Click "Save changes"**
